findings.quote: I took the speed fraction as the distance ratio
findings.note: This entry is the speed that is LEFT (v/u = 2/3) read as the distance ratio, but 'the speed fraction' does not say left or lost, so it covers mistakes[1] ('I used the speed lost as the distance ratio') just as well. At the moment of tapping, a student who used either fraction cannot tell the two routes apart, so the two wrong options are not separated.
findings.fix: I used the speed left as the distance ratio

notes: Types accepted: all three are application - the retardation idea is known but a velocity ratio is applied as a distance ratio (wrong quantity). mistakes[2] route names the squared ratio and is clearly separate. right_route 'I used the same equation for both stages' is the discriminating move (none of the three wrong entries uses v squared = u squared - 2as at all) and I did not file it, though it does not name which equation; step 1 of the solution (v = 2u/3) would have been a poor right_route because mistakes[0] shares it. Ratio re-checked: x'/x = (4/9)/(5/9) = 4/5.
